title: Chapter 81 The Counterattack Begins
content:
Chapter 81 The Counterattack Begins

After hearing what Lu Daosheng said, Yu Qingfeng was stunned, and then his expression darkened.

He also understood this.

But looking at Jiang Bei's appearance at this time.

Alas, Yu Qingfeng sighed helplessly.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, and recalling the horrible scene just now, Yu Qingfeng suddenly understood Jiang Bei.

After being invincible for a lifetime, he was suddenly crushed. It would be strange if his mentality didn't explode.

Now, we can only hope that Jiang Bei can really survive this.

In this way, Yu Qingfeng and Lu Daosheng waited for Jiang Bei quietly, and this wait lasted for several months.

.........

Xuanling Star Region.

These days, many big and small things have happened in Xuanling Star Region.

One of the things is the battle between Jiemeng and Shenshan.

Both forces are among the top forces in Xuanling Star Region.

But Shenshan's overall strength was originally not as good as Jiemeng, but what was unexpected was that Shenshan actually had another powerful person in the realm of God.

In the Xuanling Star Region, the Godly Lord Realm is already an extremely terrifying existence.

It is basically the kind that is rarely seen at ordinary times.

And the sudden appearance of a Godly Lord Realm expert in Shenshan almost instantly narrowed the gap in strength between the two sides.

Shenshan has been suppressed by the Realm Alliance for so long, and has long been full of complaints. So on the second day after the Godly Lord Realm expert in Shenshan broke through, Shenshan launched a counterattack against the Realm Alliance.

Xuanling Star Region, Nether Realm.

This is the headquarters of the Realm Alliance.

On a dark tower, the top leaders of the Realm Alliance are meeting inside.

It is worth mentioning that this tower looks very new, as if it was just built.

"Lord Wen, we have lost a lot of territory."

In the highest level, a Godly Lord said in a low voice.

Since Shenshan started the counterattack, their Realm Alliance was caught off guard and retreated repeatedly.

Hearing this, the strong man called Master Wen frowned, but then sighed.

"I know, go down first."

"Yes, Master Wen, I'll take my leave."

After he left, Wen Hong slowly walked to the bedside, looking at the distant sky. These days, he has obviously become much more haggard.

"Why do I have a very ominous feeling?"

Wen Hong murmured.

These days, he always feels uneasy, and this is not because their world alliance is defeated.

In fact, he has never looked at Shenshan from the beginning.

The small Shenshan is nothing more than that.

What he is worried about is whether all this is a bureau against his world alliance.

Because it is too coincidental.

Most of the high-level members of their world alliance have just been seriously injured by a mysterious strong man, and Shenshan has an extra strong man in the realm of God, and he directly attacks.

And because those strong men of their world alliance are still in retreat to heal their injuries, their world alliance chose to shrink their strength.

Otherwise, even if two more God Lords appeared in his Divine Mountain, his Realm Alliance would not be afraid.

Could it be that there was really some top-level expert secretly controlling all this?

Wen Hong's expression suddenly became extremely solemn.

If this was true, how terrifying would the other party be, and what was the other party's purpose?

Also, who was the mysterious expert who attacked the leader and them, and was he related to these things?

All kinds of doubts filled his mind.

And at this moment, a breath suddenly surged out of the black tower.

The next moment, footsteps sounded, and a middle-aged man slowly walked to Wen Hong's side.

"Congratulations to the leader for coming out of retreat."

Seeing the middle-aged man, Wen Hong immediately spoke respectfully.

The middle-aged man in front of him was the leader of the Realm Alliance, a terrifying expert at the peak of the God Lord realm.

However, this expert was injured by the mysterious expert not long ago, and he didn't even know who the opponent was or where he attacked.

Including the deputy leader, no one was exempted.

"Wen Hong, you have worked hard these days."

Looking at Wen Hong, Han Shaochen said.

Then, Wen Hong told Han Shaochen everything that happened in these days, including his own guesses.

After hearing this, Han Shaochen was stunned.

After a moment of silence, Han Shaochen shook his head.

"Wen Hong, you are too cautious. A trap set by a terrifying strong man? Haha, then let me ask you, what is his purpose in setting up the trap, to destroy our Jie League? Then why doesn't he do it himself?"

Hearing this, Wen Hong was silent.

These are also his questions. In fact, these are just his guesses.

Seeing Wen Hong silent, the leader of the Jie League, Han Shaochen, shook his head.

"Wen Hong, you may have been too worried these days and have some kind of paranoia. Don't worry about the things in the Jie League next time. Take a good rest. Leave the rest to us."

Hearing this, Wen Hong was a little unbelievable.

"Alliance leader, this..."

"Okay, that's it."

Looking at Han Shaochen's somewhat indifferent expression, Wen Hong was silent.

Finally, Wen Hong left.

When he left, his face was obviously a little angry, but with a little helplessness.

He worked hard for the Jiemeng, but in the end it ended up like this, but there was nothing he could do, because he touched the interests of the top this time.

Retire early was also expected, but he didn't expect it to be so soon.

In the starry sky, Wen Hong looked back at the Jiemeng for the last time, and then shook his head slightly.

"Next, where should I go?"

Wen Hong looked at the endless starry sky, with confusion in his eyes, and walked slowly and aimlessly forward.

In the Realm Alliance.

"Alliance leader, Wen Hong is indeed talented. Is it inappropriate for us to do this?"

A black shadow spoke beside Han Shaochen.

Hearing this, Han Shaochen did not speak, but just looked out the window indifferently.

At this moment, several breaths surged from the depths of the black tower, and a strong breath continued to permeate from the black tower.

Out of retreat!

All the strong men of the Realm Alliance who were injured by the mysterious strong man at that time recovered from their injuries and came out of retreat.

"Shenshan, your good days should also end."

Suddenly, countless strong men in the Nether Realm rushed out and headed towards the direction of Shenshan.

For a time, the war started again.

.........

Wanling Realm, in the Wasteland City.

These days, the Wasteland City has fallen into a long period of peace.

And with the huge resources in the Wasteland City, the strength of the Wasteland City has also begun to develop rapidly.

Nowadays, the Desolate City has long become a transcendent force in the World of All Spirits.

The status of the human race in the World of All Spirits has returned to its former glory, and even surpassed it.

"Brother Gu, has the city lord not returned yet?"

In Gu Chen's mansion, the patriarch of the Immortal Emperor Clan, Emperor Ming, came here for the nth time and asked.

At this time, Gu Chen looked a little impatient.

"Patriarch Di, I have said many times that our city lord is out on business. I will notify you when he comes back."

Hearing this, Emperor Ming nodded slightly disappointed.

At this moment, he regretted very much that he did not join the Desolate City like the Immortal Clan of the Immortals.

Looking at the Immortal Clan of the Immortals now, many talented and powerful people in their clan have begun to move into the Desolate City, and they have received considerable treatment. Li Changyue's mouth is even grinning to the back of his head.

He now feels very uncomfortable when he sees that guy's smug face.

"Brother Gu, you must help me. The Immortal Emperor Clan is very sincere."

Hearing this, Gu Chen just nodded and then waved his hand.

Seeing this, Di Ming sighed and then slowly left here.
